services:
  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7
    command:
      - --verbose
      - start-dev
      - --import-realm
    environment:
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: ${KC_USER:-root}
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KC_PASSWORD:-admin}
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_USERNAME: ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres}
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-postgres}
      KC_DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/keycloak
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: false
      KC_FEATURES: persistent-user-sessions
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: true
      KC_HTTP_MANAGEMENT_PORT: 9000
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 3000
      KC_LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: true
      KC_METRICS_ENABLED: true
      KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded
      KC_TRANSACTION_JTA_ENABLED: false
      KC_TRANSACTION_XA_ENABLED: false
    labels:
      - "traefik.enable=true"
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak.rule=Host(`auth.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak.entrypoints=${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT:-websecure}"
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak.service=keycloak"
      - "traefik.http.services.keycloak.loadbalancer.server.port=3000"
      # Health endpoint on management port
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak-health.rule=Host(`auth.${APP_HOST:-localhost}`) && PathPrefix(`/health`)"
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak-health.entrypoints=web"
      - "traefik.http.routers.keycloak-health.service=keycloak-health"
      - "traefik.http.services.keycloak-health.loadbalancer.server.port=9000"
    volumes:
      - "./.docker/infra/keycloak/green-ecolution-realm.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/green-ecolution-realm.json"
      - "./frontend/keycloak-theme/dist_keycloak/theme/green-ecolution:/opt/keycloak/themes/green-ecolution:ro"
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - auth.localhost
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - "CMD"
        - "/bin/bash"
        - "-c"
        - |
          exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000;
          echo -e "GET /health/ready HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n" >&3;
          while IFS= read -r line; do
              if [[ "$$line" =~ "200 OK" ]]; then
                  echo "HTTP 200 OK response received from localhost";
                  exit 0;
              fi
          done <&3;

          echo "No HTTP 200 OK response received from localhost";
          exit 1;
